subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain the current three built-ins plus one browser-local tweakcn import, or should OpenClaw add a first-party preset/studio flow with a different persistence contract?
rationale: Current main partially addresses customization through tweakcn, but the issue and later comments ask for in-app preview/editing and cross-browser persistence, which are product and UX commitments rather than mechanical gaps.

options.title: Define a narrowed theming spec first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker, but require a maintainer-owned spec for supported presets, editing depth, accessibility requirements, and persistence before implementation.

options.title: Stay with tweakcn import
options.body: Treat external tweakcn creation plus one browser-local import slot as the supported model and close or narrow requests for built-in studios and preset galleries.

options.title: Build first-party studio
options.body: Accept the larger Control UI surface and implement an in-app theme studio with a tested OpenClaw-owned persistence path.

recommendation.title: Define a narrowed theming spec first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker, but require a maintainer-owned spec for supported presets, editing depth, accessibility requirements, and persistence before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the current tweakcn theme implementation and is assigned to this product-direction issue.
